compatibility: Generic DSH user-message readers retain producer-owned source fields. Recall text uses existing text blocks and requires no new Session event type or role.
migration: Keep version-1 fields readable; incompatible producer-field changes require a plugin-owned reader and migration before enabling writes.

storageTypes.executionAudits: Exact L1 memory version plus policy; valid, invalid or unavailable. Missing historical-success verdicts remain pending.
storageTypes.textCorpora: Requester, tokenizer and filter isolated derived FTS data with resumable cursors and mutation sequence.
storageTypes.knowledgeInput: Optional generation and requiredExisting exact refs; new tasks freeze maxExisting and maxSearchTerms. Legacy prompt versions and call budgets remain readable.
storageTypes.taskPrompts: New L1 l1-v4 and knowledge-v6 retain explicit user declarations; old task versions keep their recorded prompts and budgets.
